study type: Comparative ex vivo study with in vitro experiment
exposure: Pregnancy status (uncomplicated term, preterm birth with intact membranes, preterm prelabor rupture of membranes [pPROM])
outcome: LOX and LOXL (1-4) enzyme expression (gene and protein localization)
cohort: Human fetal membranes collected from women with uncomplicated term pregnancies, preterm birth with intact membranes, or preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (pPROM), along with in vitro cultured human fetal membranes.
finding: LOX gene expression was significantly higher in fetal membranes from pPROM compared to preterm birth with intact membranes and term pregnancies, and LOX activity, but not expression, was increased by antioxidant treatment in vitro.
